correction: The first draft of ADR-0032 said a send that stops early leaves sent.jsonl unchanged, that ProcessSizeMax bounds what systemd-coredump reads and writes, and that no core above ProcessSizeMax gets stack text. record_sent appends each answered post before the next one, so an early stop keeps those lines; systemd-coredump captures up to MAX(ProcessSizeMax, the storage limit) within the core rlimit; stack text is skipped when the captured size exceeds ProcessSizeMax, so a core truncated to 1G under Storage=none still gets (possibly incomplete) stack text.
